item.title: Middle east live: Pentagon chief says US 'more than capable' of restarting war with Iran
item.description: The US ⁠is 'more than capable' of restarting ​attacks on Iran if a deal cannot be reached, Defense Secretary ​Pete Hegseth said on Saturday, as negotiators from Washington and Tehran worked to bridge major differences blocking an agreement.
